name: skills-matching
prompt:
Implement technician trade qualifications and job eligibility matching.

1. Complete `lib/skills.ts`:
   - `SKILL_AREAS`: `electric` ("Instalații electrice" / short "Electric"), `sanitare` ("Instalații sanitare" / "Sanitare"), `termice` ("Centrale termice" / "Termice"), `climatizare` ("Climatizare" / "Climatizare"), `frigorific` ("Frigotehnie" / "Frigorific").
   - `SKILL_LEVELS`: `avansat` ("avansat"), `incepator` ("începător").
   - `SEVERITIES`: `minor` ("Intervenție mică", hint "ex. o priză de schimbat"), `major` ("Avarie mare", hint "ex. tablou electric defect").
   - `skillAreaLabel(area: SkillArea | null, variant: "label" | "short" = "label"): string` returning `"Orice meserie"` when `area` is `null`, otherwise the matching entry's `label` or `short`.
   - `levelLabel(level: SkillLevel): string` returning `"avansat"` or `"începător"`.
   - `skillLabel(skill: Skill): string` returning `${skillAreaLabel(skill.area, "short")} · ${levelLabel(skill.level)}`.
   - `levelIn(skills: Skill[], area: SkillArea): SkillLevel | null` returning `"avansat"` if any entry for `area` is `"avansat"`, else `"incepator"` if present, else `null`.

2. Complete `lib/matching.ts` (and re-export `Eligibility` from `lib/types.ts`):
   - `activeProjectFor(employeeId: string, projects: Project[], now = Date.now()): Project | null`: return the first project whose `employeeIds` includes `employeeId` and `Date.parse(project.startsAt) <= now && Date.parse(project.endsAt) >= now`, or `null`.
   - `skillFit(task: Pick<Task, "skillArea" | "severity">, employee: Pick<Employee, "skills">)`: if `!task.skillArea`, return `{ qualified: true, skillLevel: null, needsSupport: false }`; otherwise compute `level = levelIn(employee.skills, task.skillArea)` and return `{ qualified: level !== null, skillLevel: level, needsSupport: task.severity === "major" && level === "incepator" }`.
   - `eligibleFor(task: Pick<Task, "skillArea" | "severity">, employees: Employee[], projects: Project[], now = Date.now()): Eligibility`: skip any employee with `employee.activeTask !== null`, `activeProjectFor(employee.id, projects, now) !== null`, or `employee.status` not in `["available", "on_call"]`. For remaining employees, check `skillFit(task, employee)`: if `!qualified`, increment `unqualifiedCount` and skip; if `employee.status === "on_call"`, push to `onCall`; else if `employee.lat !== null && employee.lng !== null`, push to `ranked`.

3. In `lib/demo/mock-server.ts` (`DemoBackend`), add `setSkills(employeeId: string, skills: Skill[]): Employee | null` to update an employee's `skills` array and return the employee (or `null` if unknown).

4. Add unit tests in `tests/skills-matching.test.ts` and verify `./scripts/run-tests.sh` passes.

name: geo-ranking
prompt:
Implement Bucharest geographic distance, traffic-aware ETA estimation, and candidate ranking.

1. Create `lib/geo.ts`:
   - `export const BUCHAREST = { lat: 44.4268, lng: 26.1025, label: "Bucharest" } as const`.
   - `export function haversineMeters(aLat: number, aLng: number, bLat: number, bLng: number): number` using Earth radius `R = 6_371_000` meters.
   - `export function isInsideBucharest(lat: number, lng: number, slackKm = 35): boolean` returning `haversineMeters(BUCHAREST.lat, BUCHAREST.lng, lat, lng) <= slackKm * 1000`.
   - `export function estimateDriving(straightLineMeters: number, at: Date = new Date()): { etaMinutes: number; distanceKm: number }`:
     - `distanceMeters = straightLineMeters * 1.31 + 450`
     - `distanceKm = Math.round((distanceMeters / 1000) * 10) / 10`
     - Inspect `at` in timeZone `"Europe/Bucharest"` (`Intl.DateTimeFormat` with `hour12: false`): if weekday is `Sat` or `Sun`, `averageSpeedKmh = 29`; else if `(hour >= 7 && hour < 10) || (hour >= 16 && hour < 20)`, `averageSpeedKmh = 17.5`; else `averageSpeedKmh = 24`.
     - `etaMinutes = Math.max(3, Math.round((distanceKm / averageSpeedKmh) * 60 + 2.5))`.

2. In `lib/types.ts`, export:
   - `export type EtaSource = "google_routes" | "estimated"`
   - `export interface Candidate { employee: Employee; etaMinutes: number; distanceKm: number; etaSource: EtaSource; straightLineMeters: number; rank: number; skillLevel: SkillLevel | null; needsSupport: boolean }`
   - `export interface RankingResult { candidates: Candidate[]; onCall: Employee[]; unqualifiedCount: number }`

3. In `lib/demo/mock-server.ts` (`DemoBackend`), add:
   - `ranking(taskId: string, at: Date = new Date(this.now)): RankingResult`: look up `this.task(taskId)` (if missing, return `{ candidates: [], onCall: [], unqualifiedCount: 0 }`). Call `this.sync(at.getTime())`, then call `eligibleFor(task, this.employees, this.projects, at.getTime())` and `skillFit(task, employee)` from `@/lib/matching`. Map each employee in `ranked` to a `Candidate` using `haversineMeters` and `estimateDriving(meters, at)`, `etaSource: "estimated"`, `straightLineMeters: Math.round(meters)`, and `structuredClone(employee)`. Sort by `etaMinutes` ascending, breaking ties by `distanceKm` ascending, keep the top 5 (`.slice(0, 5)`), set `rank` to `1..n`, and return `{ candidates, onCall: structuredClone(onCall), unqualifiedCount }`.
   - `candidates(taskId: string, at: Date = new Date(this.now)): Candidate[]` returning `this.ranking(taskId, at).candidates`.

4. Add unit tests in `tests/geo-ranking.test.ts` and verify `./scripts/run-tests.sh` passes.

name: dispatch-lifecycle
prompt:
Implement the dispatch job & shift state machine on `DemoBackend` in `lib/demo/mock-server.ts`.

1. Implement `protected sync(now: number = this.now): void`:
   - For each `employee` in `this.employees`, find the open task in `this.tasks` where `item.assignedEmployeeId === employee.id && (item.status === "pending_acceptance" || item.status === "in_progress")`.
   - Set `employee.activeTask` to `{ id: task.id, reference: task.reference, title: task.title, status: task.status, priority: task.priority }` if found, otherwise `null`.
   - Check `const onProject = Boolean(activeProjectFor(employee.id, this.projects, now))` using `activeProjectFor` from `@/lib/matching`.
   - If `employee.status === "offline" || employee.status === "on_call"`, leave `employee.status` unchanged; otherwise set `employee.status = task || onProject ? "busy" : "available"`.

2. Add synchronous lifecycle methods on `DemoBackend` (do NOT use `setTimeout`):
   - `assign(id: string, employeeId: string, now: number = this.now): Task | null`: require existing `task` with `task.status === "unassigned"` and existing `employee` (otherwise return `null`). Set `task.status = "pending_acceptance"`, `assignedEmployeeId = employee.id`, `assignedEmployeeName = employee.fullName`, `assignedEmployeeRole = employee.role`, `assignedAt = new Date(now).toISOString()`. If `employee.status === "on_call"`, set `employee.status = "available"`. Update `task.conversation = conversationFor(task)`, call `this.sync(now)`, and return `task`.
   - `accept(id: string, now: number = this.now): Task | null`: require `task.status === "pending_acceptance"` (else `null`). Set `task.status = "in_progress"`, `acceptedAt = new Date(now).toISOString()`, update `task.conversation = conversationFor(task)`, call `this.sync(now)`, return `task`.
   - `unassign(id: string, now: number = this.now): Task | null`: require `task.status === "pending_acceptance" || task.status === "in_progress"` (else `null`). Reset `status = "unassigned"`, `assignedEmployeeId = null`, `assignedEmployeeName = null`, `assignedEmployeeRole = null`, `assignedAt = null`, `acceptedAt = null`, `arrivedAt = null`, `conversation = []`, call `this.sync(now)`, return `task`.
   - `arrive(id: string, now: number = this.now): Task | null`: require `task.status === "in_progress"` (else `null`). Set `arrivedAt = new Date(now).toISOString()`. If assigned employee exists, set `employee.lat = task.lat + 0.00035`, `employee.lng = task.lng - 0.0004`, `employee.accuracyM = 11`, `employee.locationSource = "whatsapp_pin"`, `employee.locationUpdatedAt = task.arrivedAt`. Update `task.conversation = conversationFor(task)` and return `task`.
   - `setShift(ids: string[], action: "start" | "end" | "on_call", now: number = this.now): void`: for each existing employee in `ids`, if `action === "start"` set `status = "available"`, if `lat === null || lng === null` set `lat = 44.4362`, `lng = 26.1003`, `accuracyM = 14`, `locationSource = "whatsapp_pin"`, and set `locationUpdatedAt = new Date(now).toISOString()`; if `action === "on_call"` and `!employee.activeTask`, set `status = "on_call"`; if `action === "end"` and `!employee.activeTask`, set `status = "offline"`. Call `this.sync(now)` at the end.

3. Add unit tests in `tests/dispatch-lifecycle.test.ts` and verify `./scripts/run-tests.sh` passes.

name: clients-pv-reports
prompt:
Implement Romanian client resolution, Proces Verbal (PV) work report drafting/timelines, and task creation & completion.

1. Complete `lib/clients.ts`:
   - `DEFAULT_PV_TEMPLATE`: `headerNote: ""`, `defaultWorkDone: ""`, `defaultMaterials: ""`, `defaultObservations: "Echipamentul / instalația a fost verificată și predată în stare normală de funcționare."`, `representativeRole: "Reprezentant beneficiar (nume, semnătură, ștampilă)"`, `customFields: []`.
   - `normalizeClientKey(name: string | null | undefined): string`: lowercase `(name ?? "")`, NFD-normalize and strip diacritics (`/[\u0300-\u036f]/g`), strip company suffixes `/\b(s\.?r\.?l\.?|s\.?a\.?|sc)\b/g`, replace `/[^a-z0-9]+/g` with `" "`, and `.trim()`.
   - `resolveClient(clients, ref)`: return `null` if `!ref || !clients.length`; match by `ref.clientId` first; else compute `key = normalizeClientKey(ref.clientName)` (return `null` if empty); match exact `normalizeClientKey(c.name) === key`, else first client whose normalized key `ck` has `ck.length > 4 && (ck.includes(key) || key.includes(ck))`, else `null`.
   - `tasksForClient(client, tasks, allClients)` and `projectsForClient(client, projects, allClients)` filtering items where `resolveClient(allClients, item)?.id === client.id`.
   - `hasCustomPvTemplate(template)` returning `true` iff any of `headerNote.trim()`, `defaultWorkDone.trim()`, `defaultMaterials.trim()` is non-empty or `customFields.length > 0`.

2. Create `lib/report.ts` (and export `ReportDraft` and `ReportTimelineItem` in both `lib/types.ts` and `lib/report.ts`):
   - `ReportDraft { number: string; technician: string; workDone: string; materials: string; observations: string; contractNumber: string; representativeRole: string; customValues: PvCustomValue[] }`, `ReportTimelineItem { at: string; label: string }`.
   - `reportNumber(task: Task): string` returning `` `PV-${task.reference.replace(/^[A-Z]+-/, "")}` ``.
   - `technicianNotes(task: Task): string` joining trimmed non-empty `message.text` with `"\n"` for messages with `direction === "in" && kind === "text"`.
   - `draftFor(task: Task, client?: Client | null): ReportDraft`: if `task.report` exists, copy its fields with fallbacks (`contractNumber ?? client?.contractNumber ?? ""`, `representativeRole ?? client?.pvTemplate?.representativeRole ?? "Reprezentant beneficiar (nume, semnătură)"`, `customValues ?? mapped customFields`); otherwise combine `technicianNotes(task)` and `client?.pvTemplate?.defaultWorkDone?.trim() ?? ""` (joined by `"\n"` if both non-empty), use template defaults for `materials` and `observations`, `client?.contractNumber ?? ""`, `client?.pvTemplate?.representativeRole?.trim() || "Reprezentant beneficiar (nume, semnătură)"`, and map `customFields` (`{ label: f.label, value: f.defaultValue }`).
   - `timelineFor(task: Task, closingAt?: string): ReportTimelineItem[]`: build ordered entries for `createdAt` ("Comandă înregistrată în dispecerat"), optional `assignedAt` (`Trimisă pe WhatsApp către ${task.assignedEmployeeName ?? "tehnician"}`), optional `acceptedAt` (`${firstName} a acceptat (buton WhatsApp)`), optional `arrivedAt` ("Sosire la client, confirmată cu locația din WhatsApp"), and optional `task.completedAt ?? closingAt` (`${firstName} a apăsat „Finalizat” pe WhatsApp` if conversation has an `in` message containing `"Finalizat"`, else `"Închisă de dispecerat"`).

3. In `lib/demo/mock-server.ts` (`DemoBackend`), add:
   - `createTask(input: { title: string; clientId?: string | null; clientName: string; clientPhone?: string | null; addressText: string; sector?: string | null; lat: number; lng: number; priority: TaskPriority; notes?: string | null; skillArea?: SkillArea | null; severity?: TaskSeverity; id?: string; reference?: string }, now: number = this.now): Task`: resolve client via `resolveClient(this.clients, input)`, populate `clientId`, canonical `clientName`, fallback `clientPhone` from matched client, `reference: input.reference ?? `SV-${this.nextRef++}``, `status: "unassigned"`, `createdAt: new Date(now).toISOString()`, `severity: input.severity ?? "minor"`, push to `this.tasks`, return `task`.
   - `complete(id: string, report?: Partial<WorkReport> | null, now: number = this.now): Task | null`: return `null` if missing or `status === "completed" || status === "cancelled"`. Set `status = "completed"`, `completedAt = new Date(now).toISOString()`, update `task.conversation = conversationFor(task)`. If `report !== null`, resolve client via `resolveClient(this.clients, task)`, compute `base = draftFor(task, client)`, and set `task.report = { number: report?.number || base.number, createdAt: task.completedAt, technician: report?.technician ?? base.technician, workDone: report?.workDone ?? base.workDone, materials: report?.materials ?? base.materials, observations: report?.observations ?? base.observations, contractNumber: report?.contractNumber ?? (base.contractNumber || undefined), representativeRole: report?.representativeRole ?? base.representativeRole, customValues: report?.customValues ?? base.customValues }`. Call `this.sync(now)` and return `task`.

4. Add unit tests in `tests/clients-pv-reports.test.ts` and verify `./scripts/run-tests.sh` passes.

name: projects-timing
prompt:
Implement multi-day & intra-day project timing calculations and project management on `DemoBackend`.

1. Create `lib/project-timing.ts` (and export `ProjectPhase`, `ProjectTiming`, and `ProjectOverviewItem` in both `lib/types.ts` and `lib/project-timing.ts`):
   - `export type ProjectPhase = "planned" | "active" | "done"`
   - `export interface ProjectTiming { phase: ProjectPhase; phaseLabel: string; progressLabel: string; compact: string; duration: string; endLabel: string; progress: number }`
   - `export interface ProjectOverviewItem { project: Project; timing: ProjectTiming; client: Client | null }`
   - `export function spanLabel(ms: number): string`: let `HOUR = 3_600_000`, `DAY = 24 * HOUR`. If `ms < DAY`, `hours = Math.max(1, Math.round(ms / HOUR))`, return `hours === 1 ? "1 oră" : `${hours} ore``. Otherwise `days = Math.round(ms / DAY)`, return `days === 1 ? "1 zi" : `${days} zile``.
   - `export function projectTiming(project: Project, now: number): ProjectTiming`:
     - `start = Date.parse(project.startsAt)`, `end = Date.parse(project.endsAt)`, `total = end - start`, `duration = spanLabel(total)`, `endLabel = `până ${project.endsAt.slice(0, 10)}`` (or formatted date label starting with `"până "`).
     - If `now < start`: `phase: "planned"`, `phaseLabel: "Planificat"`, `progressLabel: `începe în ${spanLabel(start - now)}``, `compact: `în ${spanLabel(start - now)}``, `duration`, `endLabel`, `progress: 0`.
     - If `now > end`: `phase: "done"`, `phaseLabel: "Încheiat"`, `progressLabel: `încheiat acum ${spanLabel(now - end)}``, `compact: "încheiat"`, `duration`, `endLabel`, `progress: 1`.
     - Otherwise (`start <= now <= end`): `elapsed = now - start`, `multiDay = total >= 2 * DAY`, `day = Math.floor(elapsed / DAY) + 1`, `days = Math.round(total / DAY)`, returning `phase: "active"`, `phaseLabel: "În desfășurare"`, `progressLabel: multiDay ? `ziua ${day} din ${days}` : `mai sunt ${spanLabel(end - now)}``, `compact: multiDay ? `ziua ${day}/${days}` : `încă ${spanLabel(end - now)}``, `duration`, `endLabel`, `progress: total > 0 ? elapsed / total : 1`.

2. In `lib/demo/mock-server.ts` (`DemoBackend`), add:
   - `saveProject(input: Partial<Project> & { id?: string }, now: number = this.now): Project | null`: resolve client via `resolveClient(this.clients, { clientId: input.clientId, clientName: input.clientName })` from `@/lib/clients`. If `input.id` matches an existing project, update it in place (preserving existing fields not overridden, updating `clientId` / `clientName` from matched client when available), call `this.sync(now)`, and return it. Otherwise require `input.name`, `input.lat != null`, `input.lng != null`, `input.startsAt`, and `input.endsAt` (else return `null`), create a new `Project` with `id: input.id ?? crypto.randomUUID()`, `reference: input.reference ?? `PR-${this.nextProject++}``, resolved `clientId` and `clientName`, `employeeIds: input.employeeIds ?? []`, push to `this.projects`, call `this.sync(now)`, and return it.
   - `deleteProject(id: string, now: number = this.now): boolean`: remove matching project from `this.projects`, call `this.sync(now)`, return `true` if a project was removed else `false`.
   - `projectOverview(now: number = this.now): ProjectOverviewItem[]`: return all projects mapped to `{ project: structuredClone(project), timing: projectTiming(project, now), client: structuredClone(resolveClient(this.clients, project)) }`, sorted by phase order (`active` first, `planned` second, `done` third) and then `Date.parse(project.startsAt)` ascending.

3. Add unit tests in `tests/projects-timing.test.ts` and verify `./scripts/run-tests.sh` passes.

name: freshness-sla
prompt:
Implement Romanian phone formatting, technician location freshness bands, and task SLA breach/risk tracking.

1. Create `lib/format.ts` (and export `FreshnessTone`, `Freshness`, `SlaTone`, and `SlaStatus` in both `lib/types.ts` and `lib/format.ts`):
   - `export const FRESH_MINUTES = 30` and `export const STALE_MINUTES = 240`.
   - `export const SLA_MINUTES: Record<TaskPriority, number> = { emergency: 90, urgent: 240, normal: 1440 }`.
   - `export type FreshnessTone = "fresh" | "recent" | "stale" | "none"`
   - `export interface Freshness { tone: FreshnessTone; minutes: number | null; label: string; age: string }`
   - `export type SlaTone = "ok" | "at_risk" | "breached"`
   - `export interface SlaStatus { tone: SlaTone; remainingMinutes: number; targetMinutes: number }`
   - `export function formatPhone(raw: string): string`: strip non-digits (`digits = raw.replace(/\D/g, "")`). If `digits.startsWith("40") && digits.length === 11`, return `+40 ${digits.slice(2, 5)} ${digits.slice(5, 8)} ${digits.slice(8)}`. If `digits.startsWith("0") && digits.length === 10`, return `${digits.slice(0, 4)} ${digits.slice(4, 7)} ${digits.slice(7)}`. Otherwise return `raw.startsWith("+") ? raw : `+${digits}``.
   - `export function minutesSince(iso: string | null, now = Date.now()): number | null`: return `null` if `!iso` or `Number.isNaN(Date.parse(iso))`, else `Math.max(0, Math.floor((now - Date.parse(iso)) / 60_000))`.
   - `export function relativeShort(iso: string | null, now = Date.now()): string`: return `"—"` if `!iso` or invalid; let `m = minutesSince(iso, now)!`; if `m < 1` return `"acum"`, if `m < 60` return `${m} min`, if `m < 1440` return `${Math.floor(m / 60)} h`, else return `${Math.floor(m / 1440)} z`.
   - `export function getFreshness(iso: string | null, source: LocationSource | null, now = Date.now()): Freshness`: if `minutesSince(iso, now)` is `null`, return `{ tone: "none", minutes: null, label: "Fără locație", age: "—" }`. Let `label = source === "whatsapp_pin" ? "WhatsApp" : source === "manual" ? "Manual" : "Locație"` and `age = relativeShort(iso, now)`. Tone is `"fresh"` if `minutes < 30`, `"recent"` if `minutes <= 240`, else `"stale"`.
   - `export function slaStatus(task: Pick<Task, "priority" | "status" | "createdAt" | "completedAt">, now = Date.now()): SlaStatus`: `targetMinutes = SLA_MINUTES[task.priority]`, `deadlineMs = Date.parse(task.createdAt) + targetMinutes * 60_000`, `refMs = task.status === "completed" && task.completedAt ? Date.parse(task.completedAt) : now`, `remainingMinutes = Math.round((deadlineMs - refMs) / 60_000)`. If `task.status === "cancelled"`, `tone = "ok"`; else if `remainingMinutes < 0`, `tone = "breached"`; else if `remainingMinutes <= Math.round(targetMinutes * 0.25)`, `tone = "at_risk"`; else `tone = "ok"`. Return `{ tone, remainingMinutes, targetMinutes }`.

2. In `lib/demo/mock-server.ts` (`DemoBackend`), add:
   - `overdueTasks(now: number = this.now): Array<{ task: Task; sla: SlaStatus }>`: filter open tasks (`status !== "completed" && status !== "cancelled"`), compute `sla = slaStatus(task, now)`, keep those with `sla.tone === "breached" || sla.tone === "at_risk"`, and return `{ task: structuredClone(task), sla }` sorted by `sla.remainingMinutes` ascending.

3. Add unit tests in `tests/freshness-sla.test.ts` and verify `./scripts/run-tests.sh` passes.
